jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The organization is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to lead its end-to-end technology organization, spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate and platform cybersecurity.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and partnering with executive leadership, this executive provides comprehensive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer reports directly to this role.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Drive overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for the organization's core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget and drive cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner with executive leadership to transition new products from beta to market launch while actively managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.
Oversee day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning and deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures while enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on (SSO), and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close alignment with organizational leadership to ensure high uptime and integration security.
Direct organization-wide information security initiatives across corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness—including SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries—in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.
Evaluate alpha projects and proofs of concept across departments, guiding execution to integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, scalable services.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across corporate SaaS applications.
Serve as direct manager to the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), establishing shared goals and aligning product, engineering, and data strategies with enterprise infrastructure and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.
Build, mentor, and scale a service-oriented IT and security team aligned with organizational growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for staff.

Qualifications

12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including roles such as Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or Chief Technology Officer.
Demonstrated experience managing enterprise IT and information security stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, including SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Proven track record of building and leading technical teams across a broad range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through periods of organizational growth.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executive leadership, and Board members.

commensurate with experience.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options.

Paid vacation, paid holidays, and paid sick leave.
Paid parental leave.

·     Assess compliance with applicable standards and frameworks including NIST, COBIT, COSO, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and industry best practices.
·     Provide assurance over AI governance, responsible AI practices, model risk management, and compliance with emerging AI regulations and frameworks.

Who We Are

We’re Personified: a managed IT + cybersecurity services provider for campaigns, non-profits, and mission-aligned organizations. Our mission is to lead technology and security programs for our clients, enabling them to focus on their mission-critical work.

We act as an extension of our client teams — we handle all the responsibilities a traditional internal IT team would. We’re in our clients’ Slacks, we’re on a first-name basis with them (and their pets), we’re new hires’ first point of contact, and we’re the first stop for tech and cybersecurity issues. We aim to build trust, and we leverage this to keep the bad actors out.

Some of the biggest names in the progressive space have leaned on us as their trusted IT + cybersecurity partner. We are looking for top IT talent as we continue to scale our team.

About the Role

Personified is looking for a Senior Vice President of Technology to run the operational core of our technology organization: engineering, client support, cybersecurity, and IT operations. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has run these functions inside a managed service provider before and knows exactly what breaks at scale: ticket queues, on-call rotations, security posture, tooling debt, and how to fix it without slowing the team down.

You'll report to the CTO and own execution across four functional leaders and the day-to-day delivery. You are the person who makes sure the trains run on time, the team is accountable, and our 97% client retention rate stays exactly where it is, or gets better.

This role exists because Personified is growing past the point where one person can run every function directly. We need someone who has done this before, who can walk into a room of client support engineers or a security incident and immediately know what questions to ask.

Key Responsibilities

Client Support & Service Delivery
— Ensure the team hits our response-time and resolution standards across every client tier. Own escalation paths, staffing models, and the systems (like our Halo ticketing platform) that keep support predictable and measurable.

Engineering
— Oversee infrastructure, systems engineering, and technical delivery. Set standards for process discipline, documentation, and accountability across the engineering team.

Cybersecurity
— Own the operational security posture across our client base: monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and compliance readiness. Make sure security isn't a side conversation — it's built into how we operate.

IT Operations
— Drive the shift from manual, reactive IT operations toward automation and repeatable processes. Reduce the operational load on the team while improving consistency for clients.

People leadership
— Directly manage functional leaders across these four areas. Set clear expectations, run a real performance management cadence, and build a bench of leaders under you who can eventually run without your direct involvement.

Cross-functional operations
— Be the connective tissue between functions that too often operate in silos. When a client issue touches support, engineering, and security at once, you're the person who makes sure it gets resolved as one coordinated response, not three separate ones.

Metrics and accountability
— Build and own the operational scorecard for technology delivery: response times, resolution rates, security incidents, retention impact. Bring data, not anecdotes, to every conversation with the CTO.

Travel
or work or present onsite as needed to support business needs, ensure continuity of service, and represent Personified to our clients and partners at the highest level.

Skills + Experience

8+ years in technology operations leadership, with at least 4 in a managed service provider (MSP) environment, you understand ticket economics, SLAs, multi-client environments, and the specific pressure of supporting many organizations at once rather than one.

Direct people-management experience across multiple technical functions simultaneously (not just one discipline). You've managed managers, not just individual contributors.

A track record of taking an under-disciplined operation and making it measurably more consistent, without making it slower or more bureaucratic.

Real fluency in cybersecurity operations; you don't need to be the deepest technical expert in the room, but you need to know enough to ask sharp questions and hold a security leader accountable.

Experience building or scaling IT automation — you should be able to speak concretely about a time you replaced manual process with something repeatable.

A communication style that is direct and specific. You document decisions. You don't let vague problems stay vague.

What Would Make You a Great Fit Here

You've worked with or served mission-driven, nonprofit, or advocacy organizations before, and you understand why 'the client hired us so they never have to think about IT again' is a real design principle, not a slogan.

You're comfortable in a smaller, fast-moving company where your title doesn't insulate you from doing real work.

You believe good process makes teams faster, not slower, and you can tell the difference between bureaucracy and discipline.

You want to build a team, not just manage one that already exists.

Reporting Structure

This role has direct management authority over the functional leaders in Client Support, Engineering, Cybersecurity, and IT Operations. It reports to the CTO, who retains direct ownership of Technical Programs and Training/Content, along with technology strategy, senior-level accountability, and cross-company initiatives.

Annual learning & development stipend
